verdict.rationale: Postman documents a full public API (postman-docs-5) for programmatically managing assets, an OpenAPI spec is served (postman-probe-3), and this is combined with CLI/CI-CD workflows (postman-docs-6, postman-docs-19) plus an official MCP server (postman-probe-4) enabling agentic access. Missing for 10: no independent hands-on developer report confirming real-world reliability of the API for AI-driven automation.
